formula.support_tail_policy: EXACT_POISSON_CDF; evaluation thresholds are 0.5..19.5; no integer-line pricing in this candidate
formula.log_mean: log(recent_mean_batters_faced * recent_mean_k_per_batter_faced) + log(opponent_factor) + log(lineup_factor) + intercept + beta_whiff*z_whiff + beta_chase*z_chase
formula.opponent_factor: target_rel / geometric_mean(history_rel); opponent beta fixed at 1.0
formula.lineup_factor: (target_deviation / geometric_mean(history_deviation)) ** 0.5 when validated lineup component exists, otherwise 1.0

development_fit.source_policy: strictly-prior game logs plus date-bounded Baseball Savant Statcast reconstruction; sportsbook prices excluded
development_fit.outcome_use: development K counts only; no forward-evaluation outcomes

untouched_evaluation.start_condition: first eligible MLB start after the frozen development-fit artifact is merged to main and a main-provenance Statcast snapshot is available
untouched_evaluation.baseline: current shipped PITCHER_K price from pitcher_joint_engine at the same PIT timestamp
untouched_evaluation.primary_metric: mean ranked probability score across frozen thresholds; candidate minus baseline
pass_rules: 95% pitcher-cluster bootstrap upper CI of candidate-minus-baseline RPS < 0
candidate typical-line ECE <= baseline typical-line ECE + 0.005
untouched_evaluation.market_promotion: NOT_GRANTED; a separate price/ROI promotion gate remains required

prohibitions: no sportsbook price as a model feature or fit target
no coefficient tuning after first forward readout
no Model_P, staking, OFFICIAL, or bettor-facing authority from this preregistration
